comment: Deterministic Intel SGX DCAP Tier 0 vectors generated from fixed P-256/P-384 keys; no hardware is involved and no vector marks an unverified structure as valid.

suites.source: Deterministic SGX v3 quote signed with a fixed P-256 attestation key; structure per Intel DCAP Quote Library API
Quote signature checks over header || report with fixed P-256 keys
QE report binding and signature with a fixed P-256 PCK leaf
P-256 PCK chain path validation with fixed certificates; P-384 is refused, not ignored
Intel TCB Info JSON shapes evaluated against a fixed CPU SVN
End-to-end DCAP verification: quote + QE + P-256 PCK chain + TCB/QE identity
